## BlankRun · 黑着跑 0.1.10

### 新功能

- **崩溃自动亮屏**：息屏时黑着跑被“结束任务”、强制退出或崩溃，屏幕会在 1–2 秒内自动亮回来，不用再对着黑屏等下次打开。
  - 原理是一个不带界面的看门狗小进程，所以任务管理器 / 活动监视器里会多一个空闲的 BlankRun 进程（几百 KB 内存，不占 CPU）。
  - 正常退出时它什么都不做；应用内更新不受影响。
- **唤醒时先锁屏再亮屏**：开了「唤醒后锁屏」或用密码唤醒时，屏幕一亮就是锁屏界面，不会先露出桌面。

### 修复

- **Mac 虚拟屏**：能认出 BetterDisplay、DeskPad、随航（Sidecar）、AirPlay 等虚拟屏，标成「虚拟屏 · 不处理」并跳过，不会再把它当成外接屏。修复“只熄内建屏时闪一下又亮回来”。
- **Mac 不再自动把背光调到 0**：内建屏断不开时（例如其他显示器都是虚拟屏、Intel 机型、较旧的 macOS），只盖一层黑色遮罩、亮度不变，并在「设置 › 息屏」里说明原因。只有手动选「只关背光」才会调背光。
  - 如果 macOS 在 10 秒内两次自己把内建屏接回来，黑着跑不再反复断开，改为只盖遮罩。
- **Mac 显示器名称**：设置里显示真实名称（如 “Color LCD”），不再是 “Monitor #编号”；原有的选屏设置照常有效。
- **Mac 唤醒**：重连内建屏时偶发的 1001 错误不再误报成“点亮失败”。
- **Windows 防睡眠**：修复息屏时在设置里打开「防睡眠」后，唤醒了电脑也一直不睡；以及息屏时关掉「防睡眠」不生效。
- **Windows 崩溃恢复**：读不到状态的显示器也会补发一次点亮命令（D6=1）。

更新方式：在「设置 › 关于与诊断」里点「更新并重启」，或等每日检查自动提示。

## BlankRun · 黑着跑 0.1.10

### New

- **Screens come back if BlankRun crashes**: if BlankRun is ended from Task Manager, force-quit or crashes while the screens are off, they turn back on within 1–2 seconds instead of staying dark until the next launch.
  - This uses a small watchdog process with no UI, so you'll see one extra idle BlankRun process in Task Manager / Activity Monitor (a few hundred KB of memory, no CPU).
  - It does nothing on a normal quit, and in-app updates are unaffected.
- **Lock before lighting the screen**: with "Lock on wake" or password wake on, the screen now lights up on the lock screen, so the desktop is never shown first.

### Fixes

- **Mac virtual displays**: BetterDisplay, DeskPad, Sidecar, AirPlay and similar virtual screens are recognised, shown as "Virtual · skipped" and left alone, no longer counted as an external display. Fixes the built-in display flashing back on when it was the only target.
- **Mac never sets backlight 0 on its own**: when the built-in display can't be disconnected (for example all other displays are virtual, Intel Macs, older macOS), BlankRun covers it with a black overlay, leaves brightness unchanged and explains why in Settings › Screen Off. Backlight 0 is used only if you choose "Backlight only".
  - If macOS turns the built-in display back on twice within 10 seconds, BlankRun stops retrying and uses the overlay.
- **Mac display names**: Settings shows real names (such as "Color LCD") instead of "Monitor #id". Your existing display selection keeps working.
- **Mac wake**: an occasional 1001 error when reconnecting the built-in display is no longer reported as "power on failed".
- **Windows keep-awake**: fixed the PC never sleeping after wake if "Keep awake" was turned on while the screens were off, and turning it off while the screens were off having no effect.
- **Windows crash recovery**: monitors whose power state can't be read now get one power-on command (D6=1) too.

To update, click "Update and restart" in Settings › About & Diagnostics, or wait for the daily check.
